_doc: Bishop line skill definitions (spec #372, ticket BS2 #374). Each skill ticket appends its own region of `skills` (separate tickets, separate regions): BS4 (#376) Heal (2301002, moved from magician.json); BS5 (#377) Holy Arrow (2301005, moved from magician.json), Shining Ray (2311004), Angel Ray (2321007) and Teleport (2301001, moved from magician.json as teleport_cleric); BS6 Genesis (2321008) and Big Bang (2321001, via extends big_bang); BS7 Summon Dragon (2311006) and Bahamut (2321003); BS8 Resurrection (2321006). A pool key with no entry here stays inert: it is never offered or learned. Tier C cooldowns are the F/P base values x0.4 (GAME_DESIGN 7.80).

holy_arrow._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
holy_arrow.name: Holy Arrow
holy_arrow.desc: Cleric. Shoots a holy arrow at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster by firing Holy Arrows. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

holy_arrow._tuning: Tier C: same flight, reach, radius and recast as Fire Arrow, cooldown 0.4 s (1.0 s x0.4), default eight-rank table; canonical mad/mastery and the holy element are tier A.

shining_ray._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
shining_ray.name: Shining Ray
shining_ray.desc: Strikes nearby monsters with a burst of holy light.

text.desc: Attacks surrounding monsters with a ray of holy light. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

shining_ray._survivor: Tier C: auto-cast with at least one monster in the canonical box, 1.2 s cooldown (3 s x0.4), magic2 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: lt/rb (half-width 150 to level 10, 160 at 11-20, 170 from 21), mobCount 6, mad/mastery and elemAttr h from Skill.wz, action magic2; effect and hit/0 only (no ball), Use sound only.

angel_ray._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
angel_ray.name: Angel Ray
angel_ray.desc: Fires a heavy holy ray at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a heavy ray of holy light. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

angel_ray._tuning: Tier C: nearest auto-cast, the Fire Arrow flight (range 480, 520 px/s) with radius 14, cooldown 1.0 s (2.5 s x0.4), one shot, shoot1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: mad/mastery and elemAttr h from Skill.wz, its own single-frame ball/0, action shoot1.

teleport_cleric.name: Teleport
teleport_cleric.desc: Press X and a direction to blink to a platform. Hold X to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Teleport key with an arrow key to teleport a set distance to another platform in the same map. Hold the key to keep teleporting.

teleport_cleric._teleport: Tier C: 0.3 s survivor repeat delay; bot blinks from threats within 60 px. Canonical mpCon and range from Skill.wz (130 to level 10, then +2 a level to 150 at level 20).

heal._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.83. Every effect names a stat Heal's rule reads: heal_power and heal_threshold (BS4), area (the undead box) and damage (the undead strike, resolved).
heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Restores HP below half health, or strikes undead inside its holy box.

text.desc: Recovers your HP when it falls below half, and damages every undead monster in the area.

heal._heal: Tier A: mpCon/hp/lt/rb from v83. Tier B: undead formula; weak historical recovery coefficients. Tier C: provisional choice of the unverified single-target recovery fit (docs/research/cleric-heal.md), below-half trigger (strictly below: a hit exactly at the threshold waits), 2 s recast, every undead in the box, 0.8 s stance, the recovery only for a character below the resolved threshold. BS4 (#376): the undead strike multiplies its bounds by the resolved damage; the default 30-level table gives eight ranks.
